BrushLLM Player uses a shared desktop layout and a dedicated widescreen play icon across macOS and Windows.

- The left rail keeps Sources, Playlist, History, and Bookmarks within reach. Fullscreen gives the video the whole window.
- Timeline hover shows the target time. The media title follows the theme, and playback uses a single mpv instance.
- Choose the macOS Apple Silicon disk image or the Windows installer that matches your processor. Both include mpv.

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.11-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows, x64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.11-x64.exe` |
| Windows, ARM64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.11-arm64.exe` |

新版采用独立的宽屏播放图标。播放列表、历史与书签仍在侧栏，全屏为视频腾出整个窗口。进度条悬停显示目标时间，片名颜色随主题设置。请按系统与处理器选择对应的安装包。
